goal: Offline licensing and cache headers in Nginx configuration, public/models/, and backend asset endpoints.
summary: Implemented offline licensing and caching headers across Nginx reverse proxy configurations, public/models/ 3D manifests, backend asset endpoints, and frontend offline asset cache manager. Guarantees that private assets require HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens or Authorization headers and are served with strict no-store headers ('private, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0'); public assets with verified content hashes (SHA-256) receive immutable caching ('public, max-age=31536000, immutable') and matching ETags; offline caching is restricted strictly to assets with approved educational/public domain licenses; and revoked assets immediately emit cache invalidation headers ('no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0, s-maxage=0', 'Pragma: no-cache', 'Expires: 0') preventing stale CDN or client serving.

invariants_enforced.offline_licensing_gate: Only assets with verified, non-revoked, approved licenses (CC BY 4.0, Educational Fair Use, Public Domain) and offline_licensing_allowed=true can be stored in offline caches / local storage. Proprietary, all-rights-reserved, or unlicensed assets are blocked from offline storage.
invariants_enforced.private_assets_signed_tokens: Private or unpublished assets require valid HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens (with timestamp, expiration, client ID, and asset ID) or Authorization headers (admin/staff/teacher). Tampered, expired, or mismatched tokens fail closed with HTTP 403 / InvalidSignedTokenError.
invariants_enforced.private_assets_no_store: Private assets are strictly served with 'Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0' and 'Pragma: no-cache', ensuring they are never cached by shared CDNs or public proxies.
invariants_enforced.public_assets_immutable_hash: Public assets with cryptographic content hashes (SHA-256) receive 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' and strong ETags matching their content hash. Conditional requests with matching If-None-Match receive HTTP 304 Not Modified.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_revoked_asset_cdn_invalid: When an asset is revoked, its rights status transitions to 'revoked' and it is registered in the revocation registry. Conditional requests (If-None-Match with cached ETag) strictly reject with HTTP 403 and emit 'Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, max-age=0, s-maxage=0', 'Pragma: no-cache', and 'Expires: 0' to immediately bust and purge intermediate CDN and browser caches. Revoked assets are never served from stale cache beyond policy.
invariants_enforced.nginx_edge_policy_enforcement: Nginx configurations (nginx-site.conf, nginx-lms.conf, nginx-lms-histolab.conf, nginx-luunien-staging.conf) configure 3D models with immutable cache headers and establish dedicated /assets/private/ ingress guards requiring authentication token checks.

changes.description: Created comprehensive offline licensing, signed token verification (HMAC-SHA256), cache header policy engine, and cache revocation/anti-stale CDN protection registry.
Updated enforce_cdn_distribution_policy and revoke_manifest_rights to integrate immutable cache headers, offline licensing flags, and automatic revocation registration.

Enhanced GET /api/v1/imperial/assets/{asset_id}/image with strict offline licensing validation, signed token verification for private assets, immutable cache headers for public hashed assets, conditional request (304) support, and anti-stale CDN headers on revocation. Added POST /assets/{asset_id}/signed-token, POST /assets/{asset_id}/revoke, and GET /assets/{asset_id}/license-check.
Added AssetSignedTokenRequest, AssetSignedTokenResponse, AssetRevokeRequest, AssetRevokeResponse, and AssetLicenseCheckResponse schemas.
Added offline_licensing_allowed, cache_control_policy, is_private, revoked_at, and revocation_reason columns to HistoricalAsset. Created AssetCacheRevocation table model.
Created purely additive Alembic migration adding offline licensing and cache policy columns to historical_assets and creating asset_cache_revocations table.
Configured immutable cache headers (max-age=31536000) for /assets/models/ and created protected /assets/private/ location guard requiring token or Authorization header.
Configured immutable cache headers (max-age=31536000) for /assets/models/ and created protected /assets/private/ location guard requiring token or Authorization header.
Configured immutable cache headers (max-age=31536000) for /assets/models/ and created protected /assets/private/ location guard requiring token or Authorization header.
Configured immutable cache headers (max-age=31536000) for /assets/models/ and created protected /assets/private/ location guard requiring token or Authorization header.
Updated all 9 3D urn manifests and index.json with offline_licensing_allowed=true, offline_license_type, and cache_policy specifying immutable cache control.
Mirrored offline licensing and cache_policy across frontend 3D manifests.
Implemented TypeScript client-side offline asset caching manager enforcing offline licensing, immediate eviction on revocation, private asset protection, and signed request building.
Created comprehensive Vitest unit test suite covering offline licensing validation, signed token request construction, and negative abuse cache purging upon revocation.

Created complete integration test suite with 12 test cases covering manifest offline licensing, signed token lifecycles, private no-store headers, public immutable hashes, negative abuse stale CDN protection, FastAPI endpoints, Nginx config rules, and database persistence.
